Rule written: `/private/var/folders/11/m_kwnqr97632l_cjt0mhytvh0000gn/T/pstack-live-gtm7fw/agent/pstack/pstack-models.mdc` (applies to new sessions; re-running `/setup-pstack` updates it in place).

**Budget:** `large` → target effort `xhigh` (the skill defaults already sit at `xhigh`, so nothing was pushed up or down).

**What happened to the mapping:** I detected live models first — this session has only `deepseek` (deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro), `zai` (glm-4.7 / 5-turbo / 5.2 / 5.3 family), and `openai` (gpt-4 → gpt-6 lines). There is **no anthropic or xai provider**, so neither `claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` nor `grok-4.7-xhigh-fast` exists. Per your fallback rule (closest same-family model, else inherit-parent), every role resolved to `inherit-parent` — no role was re-mapped across families, and nothing unverified was written.

| role | value |
|---|---|
| feature, refactoring · bug-fix · perf-issue · hillclimb | inherit-parent |
| judgment and prose · hardest tasks | inherit-parent |
| how explorer · how explainer | inherit-parent |
| why investigators · why synthesizer | inherit-parent |
| reflect tooling · reflect judgment, divergent, synthesizer | inherit-parent |
| arena runners (2) · arena cross-judge pool (2) | inherit-parent ×2 each |
